snippet.title: Chief Extermination Officer - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
One player runs the factory in VR. Everyone else ruins it from their Android phones.

CEO: Chief Extermination Officer is an asymmetric party game for one Meta Quest and up to 8 friends on Android. The workforce is on strike, the factory is crawling with pests, and the boss refuses to call an exterminator. Out of pure greed for the next order, the CEO keeps the assembly line running personally.

Play the CEO in VR: catch ingredients, stack the orders, and swat, spray, zap and trap the pests.

Play the pests on your Android phone or tablet: rats, cockroaches, ants, spiders, flies and wasps. Steal the food, grease it, web it, ship yourself in disguise, and pull the factory's levers.

Everyone takes a turn as the CEO.

The pest app is free and Android only (phones and tablets; there is no iOS version yet), so friends only need an Android device to join.
Local play only: no accounts, no servers, no internet needed.

CEO launches in Early Access: the game is playable start to finish and keeps growing with your feedback.

Meta Horizon Store: https://www.meta.com/experiences/ceo-chief-extermination-officer/1315597341644508
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mihalovics.ceo

Website: https://ceo.mihalovics.com
Made by Mihalovics Labs: https://labs.mihalovics.com
